messages:
maria: Heads-up — some eu-west-1 GPU nodes can't pull model artifacts, started ~12:05 UTC. Canary jobs showing fetch timeouts to model-store S3 URLs. Anyone seeing this?
chris: yep, dashboard spike in 504s for galaxy-model-store from pool eu-gpu-a. affecting canaries + a handful of customer jobs.
alex: can you paste the curl -v from a failing node?
maria: ```
$ curl -v https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/galaxy/v2.tar.gz 
* Rebuilt URL to: https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/galaxy/v2.tar.gz
*   Trying 52.95.12.34...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* connect to 52.95.12.34 port 443 timed out: Operation timed out
* Failed to connect to 52.95.12.34 port 443: Operation timed out
* Closing connection 0
curl: (7) Failed to connect to 52.95.12.34 port 443: Operation timed out
```
nacl-bot: NACL change detected: acl-08f4 applied rule #110 DENY TCP ports 1024-65535 from 0.0.0.0/0 by @ben in PR #1892 at 11:58 UTC
rachel: whoa. DENY ephemeral ports is a nuclear option. Which subnet did that ACL attach to?
ben: that was part of the PCI lockdown task, targeted subnets: sn-eu-gpu-a, sn-eu-gpu-b. intention was to harden host-facing traffic, but maybe we mis-scoped.
chris: if you deny 1024-65535 on the subnet with NAT gateway or nodes, return traffic won't make it back — NACLs are stateless.
alex: tcpdump from node sn-eu-gpu-a-02 shows SYNs leaving but no SYN-ACKs back. snippet: ```
09:12:45.123456 IP 10.2.6.12.49820 > 52.95.12.34.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
09:12:45.223567 IP 10.2.6.12.49820 > 52.95.12.34.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
# no replies observed
```
maria: that matches the curl timeouts. The NAT gateway IPs are in the same subnet (we use EIPs on the NAT GW). If the ACL denies ephemeral ports inbound to the subnet, the gateway's reply packets won't be accepted.
ben: hmm, we applied the deny to the whole subnet based on a misunderstanding of the compliance checklist. Rolling back rule #110 now.
ben: rolled back rule #110 — removed DENY 1024-65535 from acl-08f4 (11:22 UTC).
deploy-bot: change applied: acl-08f4 updated (rollback) — runbook step: validate egress test.
achris: canaries starting to retry. maria, can you re-run the failing job?
maria: re-run triggered. curl now: ```
$ curl -I https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/galaxy/v2.tar.gz
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/x-tar
Content-Length: 12345678
Date: Thu, 17 Mar 2027 11:25:03 GMT
```
maria: canaries passed, model pulls green. Thanks.
rachel: action items: 1) audit all NACL changes in PRs for subnets tagged with "nat-gateway" or "has-eips"; 2) add preflight check to infra-cluster pipeline that fails if a DENY ephemeral rule targets those subnets; 3) document this in the network playbook.
chris: +1. I'll open a quick ticket and add the preflight hook.
ben: sorry for the noise — we thought the rule was limited to host-facing subnets only. will be more careful and run an impact scan next time. :bow: 
maria: no worries — glad rollback fixed it. Leaving the thread open until preflight is in.
